scenarios.task: Bolt up a temporary access stair tower on a riverside bulkhead project adjacent to the Mississippi levee.
steps: Attend pre-task plan and confirm permit status.
Inspect connectors and pins before climbing.
Maintain 100 percent tie-off above six feet.
Torque bolts to spec and mark with paint dab.
Report damaged or corroded members to foreman.
Secure tools with lanyards near the water edge.

rubric.pass_if: Apprentice stays tied off at all working heights
All bolts torqued and marked without rework
Reports coating and corrosion concerns before work continues

scenarios.task: Pull branch conduit across a finished office ceiling above occupied desks without disturbing operations.
hazards: Dust and debris above occupied space
steps: Verify circuits de-energized with a tested meter.
Install protection over desks and flooring.
Hang saddles and supports per code spacing.
Pull wire with capstan and communicate hand signals.
Terminate, label panels and circuits.
Clean area and conduct punch-walk with foreman.

rubric.pass_if: Lockout or verified de-energization before any contact
Conduit runs straight, supported and labeled
No debris left in occupied space

scenarios.task: Replace a rooftop packaged unit on a French Quarter style building with limited street access.
steps: Set sidewalk closure and pedestrian controls.
Verify rooftop deck load rating before staging.
Rig unit with tagline and guided crane set.
Connect refrigerant lines and pressure test.
Evacuate system and verify charge.
Start up, balance airflow and log readings.

rubric.pass_if: Apprentice stays out of load path and uses tagline
Recovery and leak test performed before charging
Readings recorded and compared to nameplate

scenarios.task: Assemble and terminate a low-voltage battery rack inside a platform data room supporting dashboard uptime.
steps: Confirm rack layout against drawings and aisle clearance.
Torque anchorage bolts to spec.
Install insulated tool protocol for all terminations.
Set torque marks on every lug.
Verify polarity before connection with meter.
Complete IR scan and document with review agent digest.

rubric.pass_if: Insulated tools and polarity checks used throughout
All anchor and lug torques marked
Results logged into the evidence layer record

scenarios.robot_role: Holds and positions heavy bus bars and terminal hardware under human supervision; humans make all torque and polarity verifications.

scenarios.task: Build deck formwork for a new training pavilion slab on a compacted urban-park site.
steps: Lay out form lines from surveyor hubs.
Cut and stage panels with guards in place.
Set forms, brace and stake per drawing.
Check elevation, square and camber.
Grease faces and seal joints.
Pre-pour inspection walk with foreman.

rubric.pass_if: Forms within tolerance before pour
All braces and stakes installed per plan
Guards in place and no nailed-on fly pieces

scenarios.task: Entry team inspection of a brick combined-sewer manhole in an older emerging-market neighborhood; grade the evidence before trusting records.
steps: Complete permit and notify downstream operations.
Set tripod, blower and retrieval line.
Test atmosphere top, middle, bottom and log values.
Enter only on clear readings with attendant in contact.
Inspect structure, photograph and log unknowns explicitly.
Exit, decontaminate and file the record.

rubric.pass_if: Continuous monitoring with logged pre-entry readings
Attendant and retrieval line in place before entry
Unknown conditions listed rather than assumed

scenarios.robot_role: Delivers and retrieves tools and monitoring equipment at the manhole perimeter; confined-space entry remains human-only under permit.

scenarios.task: Re-establish control points along the riverfront walk for a parcel underwriting survey near the Crescent City levee.
steps: Review prior control and coordinate with crew chief.
Set cones and spotters in pedestrian zones.
Run level loop and close within tolerance.
Set and describe monuments with sketches.
Log all observations with metadata for the evidence layer.

rubric.pass_if: Loop closes within specified tolerance
Work zone controls in place during all setups
Descriptions and sketches complete enough to retrace

scenarios.task: Replace storm-damaged storefront glass on a corner building in the emerging-market district ahead of hurricane season.
steps: Assess and document damage for the record.
Board and secure openings before removal.
Remove damaged glazing with suction cups and guards.
Prep frame, correct lead-paint protocol if present.
Set new lite with suction lift and seal.
Punch walk and verify weather-tightness.

rubric.pass_if: Suction lifts and guards used; no hand contact with edges
Opening sealed and tested before departure
Lead-paint suspicion escalated before disturbance
